ledger.claim: The driver never reached the pickup point, and his own trace proves it. The trace carries 69 fixes at a 10-second cadence with 100% coverage across the whole approach, and over that entire track the closest he ever came to the pickup pin was 156.99 m — 107 m outside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius that POL-NS-02 sets. The derived arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-radius fixes and 0 continuous in-geofence runs. POL-NS-02's proximity test therefore fails, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails with it, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

Even if arrival were taken as given, the dwell is zero. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and the effective in-geofence dwell measured under POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-01(c) is 0 seconds: longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0 and the derived shortfall is 180.0 s against the STANDARD minimum. POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable on that shortfall — whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages — and no driver compensation is payable. The 4.50 cancellation-fee line that EV-FARE-02711 shows as charged is therefore refundable in full.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the cancellation to fall at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed. The dwell never elapsed — it never began, because there was no qualifying in-geofence fix — so the driver's termination at 20:32:36 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW cannot satisfy limb (d), any more than the arrival event can satisfy limb (b). The RIDER_NO_SHOW code is not the rider's admission in this record; it is the driver's own selection.

The arrival marker on this trip is a driver button press (trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker = BUTTON), so the platform-confirmed-arrival shortcut in POL-NS-12 is unavailable by its own terms — it covers only GPS_AUTO arrivals and leaves a pressed marker to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05. The driver's statement that he 'was at the pickup as shown on the map' is thus uncorroborated by any telemetry: the record shows a marker at 20:28:14 and a nearest approach of 157 m, and under POL-NS-02 the button press does not establish arrival.

Nothing in this record lets the dwell be accumulated to reach the minimum. EV-ADVIS-02711-01 is MISSING — issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, no payload — so no traffic advisory covers this pickup road, and POL-NS-06(i)'s precondition (a present and populated advisory of an admissible type covering the pickup road and the waiting window) cannot be met. The derived block records the limb as unavailable for exactly that reason. The required 180 seconds accordingly stands unreduced and unsummed, and the full refund under POL-NS-06 follows. (I disclose the impairment: the artifact is MISSING and carries weight 0.0; it is cited for the absence itself, which is citable.)

The rider was not the party who failed to appear. Her own track carries 47 fixes, every one qualifying, and every one within 14.79 m of the pickup pin (mean 12.03 m) across 20:26:34 to 20:33:28 — far inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius — and she named her sub-location in the chat log at 20:28:34 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A'). To the extent POL-NS-03 is engaged at all on a closest approach of 157 m, which is inside its 400 m ceiling, limb (i) allocates this mislocation to the driver: the rider stated her entrance, the driver read it and answered only 'ok' at 20:29:04, and the trace never shows him closing the last 157 m before he cancelled at 20:32:36 — so he receives no compensation. I do not rely on POL-NS-04 to exonerate the rider: the driver did reply within 120 seconds of her message, so limb (b) of that clause is not met and I concede the point.

This case is decidable now and should be refunded, not held. The apparent conflict between the 20:28:14 arrival event and a trace that never enters the geofence is resolved by POL-NS-01(b) and POL-NS-02, which require the trace to corroborate the arrival event and which the button marker does not satisfy — so the POL-NS-09(b) trigger is not engaged. Nor is any integrity limb engaged: the trace is COMPLETE with 100% coverage, 0 gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0 and 69 fixes across the window, and the arrival event timestamp 20:28:14 sits exactly on a fix timestamp, so there is no clock skew under POL-NS-08(a) and no trace defect under POL-NS-08(b). The deciding fact rests on an artifact at weight 1.0, above the confidence floor, and escalation under POL-NS-09 would wrongly leave the rider's 4.50 held.

The remedy the rider seeks is the refund of the cancellation-fee line only. EV-FARE-02711 shows the 4.50 cancellation fee as the entirety of total_charged, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0, and the fare reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so there is no fare defect and no booking or platform fee to net off (platform_fee is 0.0; base_fare, distance_fare and time_fare are all 0.0). A full refund of 4.50, with driver_compensation_sgd null, is the ruling the record supports.

The driver's own trace places him 156.99 m from the pickup pin at his closest recorded approach anywhere in the 69-fix run - outside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius that POL-NS-02 fixes for this zone class, but far inside the 400 m ceiling POL-NS-03 sets for a wrong-face-of-venue arrival. The rider's own account ('he stayed on the other side and cancelled') describes exactly that situation, not an abandoned job, so the driver attended the venue and the case is decided under POL-NS-03 rather than as a driver who never came.

Limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied and the driver's cancellation was not premature in time on the platform's own clock: the trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 20:28:14 and the cancellation at 20:32:36, an elapsed wait of 4.4 minutes (262 seconds) against the 180 second free_wait_sec in force for this trip under platform_policy. The driver gave the rider substantially longer than the free waiting period the fee pays for, whatever the geofence arithmetic finally shows.

POL-NS-05 catches a false arrival marker only where the fix matched to the arrival timestamp puts the driver more than 300 m from the pin or travelling at 15 km/h or more. Neither trigger is made out on this record: the driver's closest fix anywhere in the trace is 156.99 m from the pin, inside the 300 m leash, and the trace contains stationary 0.0 km/h samples. No false-arrival finding or POL-NS-05(ii) referral should be recorded against this driver.

The rider's POL-NS-04 route fails at limb (b). The rider's locating message was sent at 20:28:34 and the driver replied 'ok' at 20:29:04 - thirty seconds later, and read at 20:29:14 - well inside the 120 second window limb (b) allows. The driver neither ignored the message nor left it unanswered, so the rider cannot be exonerated on a driver coordination failure and the case must be decided on the arrival and dwell arithmetic.

There is no farming pattern and no escalation ground on the profiles. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check requires driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d of 4 or more AND a rate above 0.08; this driver shows 2 terminations against 87 completed trips in the same window, a rate of 0.023, so the check does not trip. The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is not the trailing-30-day field the clause names and may not be substituted for it, and both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged either.

Every artifact is COMPLETE at weight 1.0; the GPS trace carries 100.0 percent coverage, a 10 second cadence and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, so the POL-NS-08(a) clock-skew, (b) trace-defect and (c) chat-defect limbs are not engaged and no POL-NS-09(e) escalation arises; and the fare breakdown's cancellation-fee line of 4.50 SGD reconciles exactly with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50, so POL-NS-08(d) is satisfied and the amount itself is not in issue. On a clean record the single live question is whether the fee is chargeable at all.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the rider's claim is upheld, and the SGD 4.50 no-show fee is refunded in full.

What the record shows. The driver accepted the trip at 20:22:12 on 17 Aug, pressed 'arrived' at 20:28:14 and cancelled at 20:32:36 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW (EV-TRIP-02711). The platform charged the rider SGD 4.50 (EV-FARE-02711: total_charged 4.50, cancellation_fee 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00).

Arrival fails. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02711, weight 1.0, COMPLETE, 69 fixes at a 10 s cadence, 100% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0) places the driver's closest approach to the pickup pin at 156.99 m anywhere in the trip, with 0 fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius and 0 continuous in-geofence runs. POL-NS-02's proximity test therefore fails, and with it POL-NS-01 limb (b): the driver did not arrive at the pickup point. POL-NS-12 does not help the driver - arrival_marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so a pressed marker stays subject to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05, and the bare statement that he 'was at the pickup as shown on the map' is corroborated by no telemetry.

Dwell fails independently. The free waiting period in force is 180 s (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The effective in-geofence dwell is 0 s, measured - per POL-NS-01(c) - from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the 'arrived' tap. POL-NS-06 therefore makes the fee not chargeable on a 180 s shortfall, with no driver compensation, and POL-NS-01 limb (d) cannot be met either because the dwell never elapsed. The driver's contrary point, that 262 s elapsed between the tap and the cancellation against a 180 s period, is rejected: that interval is the platform's wait timer, not the dwell the clause measures from the GPS clock, which never began. The rider's point that nothing can be accumulated is accepted: EV-ADVIS-02711-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0; cited for its absence, which is citable), so POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable, accumulation is defeated, and the 180 s stands unreduced.

Wrong-entrance reading changes nothing. The driver's nearest position, 157 m, is outside the 50 m radius but inside the 400 m ceiling of POL-NS-03, so even on the reading that he attended the wrong face of the venue the rider is still refunded in full; POL-NS-03 decides the refund exactly as POL-NS-02 does. Its compensation allocation goes against the driver: the rider named her sub-location in the chat log at 20:28:34 ('im at the main entrance next to the taxi stand, block A'), the driver read it and answered only 'ok' at 20:29:04, and the trace never shows him closing the last 157 m before he cancelled - limb (i) puts the loss on the driver. Limb (ii)'s pin-ambiguity goodwill does not apply because registered_pickup_points is 1, not 2 or more.

Other points answered. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider (the driver replied within 120 s, 30 s after her message, read 10 s later), but it does not need to - the refund follows from POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06. POL-NS-05 records no false-arrival finding and produces no referral: its test reads the fix matched to the 20:28:14 marker, the driver's nearest approach anywhere in the trace is 156.99 m (inside its 300 m leash) and the trace carries stationary samples, so neither trigger - over 300 m, or 15 km/h or more - is established.

Integrity, confidence and escalation. Nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08: the trace is COMPLETE with no (a) clock skew and no (b) trace defect; the chat log holds 2 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count, with no sequence gap (c); and the 4.50 cancellation line equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 (d). The deciding facts rest on artifacts at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.9. POL-NS-09 is not engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor; the arrival event and the trace are reconciled by POL-NS-01(b)/POL-NS-02/POL-NS-12 rather than left in unresolved contradiction; both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations against 87 completed trips, rate 0.023); and no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence. The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is context-only under POL-GEN-01 and was used for nothing.

The money. The refund is the cancellation-fee line only - 4.50, which is the whole of total_charged (base_fare, distance_fare, time_fare, platform_fee and waiting_time_fee are all 0.00). driver_compensation_sgd is null, and referrals is empty. The monetary effect of 4.50 is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of 8.00, so it executes automatically on issue; this is a provisional ruling and either party may appeal once, within 30 days, under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
